receiver_contract: postMessage IPC deserializes options.headers as HashMap<String, String>
current_behavior: Record-form headers serialize as an object and reach the Rust map shape.
A Headers object JSON-serializes without its entries, so postMessage loses those headers.
Tuple-list HeadersInit JSON-serializes as a sequence, which does not match the Rust string-map receiver.
Android regular invokes use the postMessage path directly, so this is not limited to fallback after a custom-protocol failure.
candidate: Normalize options.headers through new Headers(...) and Object.fromEntries(...entries()) before postMessage serialization.
limitations: The standalone HeadersInit model did not receive a retained Actions receipt.
The revised IPC candidate model executed normalization for record, Headers, and tuple-list inputs, but it did not pass those values through a real Android WebView/Rust IPC boundary.
